entities.name: Dan Biggar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daniel Biggar is a Welsh former professional rugby union player and current director at United Rugby Championship club Scarlets. A Wales international, Biggar played fly half and was twice selected to tour with the British and Irish Lions.
